acceptance.assertion: Immediately before prepare-intent and again before apply, GitHub main is freshly observed; the exact target contains this protected authority merge and all then-current legitimate main merges, and required validate (3.10), validate (3.12) and registry-registration-preflight/freshness checks for that exact main revision are successful.

Immediately before prepare-intent and again before apply, a typed precondition readback proves that the active deployment-manifest source_commit and canonical Registry source identity are equal, and that this active source is either exactly the registered deployed source f3b2f41fcc7d8ec711edf72d08e8d9f1aba123db or a verified Git ancestor of the freshly selected target main commit. Any deployment/Registry identity mismatch, unrelated or diverged source history, unavailable ancestry proof, or target drift blocks the runtime effect fail-closed.

This authority starts at most one runtime effect. Failed, unclear, timeout or transport-ambiguous outcomes are read back from attempt/result, manifest, launcher, package, snapshot and authority-consumption evidence before any further action; no blind retry is permitted.

After a successful refresh, deployment manifest, immutable release, package tree, launcher pair and canonical Registry snapshot bind the same freshly observed source commit, and bureau runtime-identity is integrity-valid at that exact target.
The authority is consumed exactly once after successful immutable readback and grants no queue, claim, dispatch, task-supply, product-code, foreign-work or general repository mutation authority.

approval.note: Single-use target-bound bootstrap only. The current direct user request to fetch and execute the next Bureau task authorizes the necessary runtime convergence as its prerequisite, but no effect may start until fresh GitHub main/CI observation, exact target binding, authoritative TaskSpec preflight, the typed source-ancestry precondition, live intent-bound leases and runtime-refresh readback gates all pass. The source-ancestry precondition is repeated immediately before apply. No blind retry after any effect-started ambiguity.

goal: Execute exactly one new target-bound Bureau runtime refresh to the freshly observed protected heimgewebe/bureau main after this authority itself is merged as one create-only TaskSpec and adopted missing-only into the authoritative StateStore. The sole purpose is to converge the immutable Bureau runtime from deployed source f3b2f41fcc7d8ec711edf72d08e8d9f1aba123db with current canonical main so normal reviewed Bureau pickup can resume. This authority grants no queue, claim, dispatch, product-code, foreign-work or general repository authority.

rollback.strategy: The currently integrity-valid deployed Bureau runtime remains authoritative until a new immutable result is fully read back. If the source-ancestry precondition fails or the new effect becomes unclear, preserve all precondition, attempt, intent, workspace, backup, manifest, Registry, authority and lease evidence and do not retry. Reconciliation requires a separately authorized successor path.
